3 مايحهُ , (A, K,) inf. n. مُمَايَحَةٌ, (A,) (tropical:) He commingled, or conversed, or held intercourse, with him; (K;) namely, with a Sultán; and in like manner with women. (A.) ―
-b2- بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُ مَمَايَحَةٌ وَمُمَالَحَةٌ (tropical:) [Between me and him are a commingling, or converse, or intercourse, and fellowship in eating.] (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
